claims.claim_text: The section provides information intended to enable users of general purpose financial reports to understand the current and anticipated effects of sustainability-related risks and opportunities on the entity’s business model and value chain.
entities: users of general purpose financial reports
claims.support_notes: Text explicitly states intent to enable understanding of current and anticipated effects on business model and value chain; does not provide entity-specific effects.

claims.claim_text: The section provides information intended to enable users to understand the effects of sustainability-related risks and opportunities on the entity’s financial position, financial performance and cash flows for the reporting period and anticipated effects over the short, medium and long term, considering how these risks and opportunities are factored into financial planning.
entities: users of general purpose financial reports
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Financial position, financial performance and cash flows
claims.support_notes: Matches IFRS S1 strategy disclosure objective language; no quantified impacts included.

claims.claim_text: For these disclosures, the entity defines time horizons aligned to planning horizons used for strategic decision-making: short term up to 12 months, medium term 1–3 years, and long term more than 3 years.
claims.support_notes: Provides explicit definitions and states linkage to planning horizons.

claims.claim_text: When describing the effects of sustainability-related risks and opportunities, the entity specifies whether effects are expected to occur over the short, medium and/or long term.
claims.support_notes: States an intended practice to specify time horizons; does not enumerate specific risks/opportunities.

claims.claim_text: The entity discloses information enabling users to understand current and anticipated effects of sustainability-related risks and opportunities on the entity’s business model and value chain, including where such risks and opportunities are concentrated (e.g., geographical areas, facilities, types of assets).
entities: users of general purpose financial reports
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Business model and value chain
claims.support_notes: Describes required disclosure content categories; no entity-specific concentrations provided.

claims.claim_text: In considering sustainability-related risks and opportunities in strategy and decision-making, the entity discloses progress against previously disclosed plans (where applicable) and material trade-offs considered between sustainability-related risks and opportunities and other strategic objectives.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Effects on strategy and decision-making
claims.support_notes: States disclosure topics; does not provide actual progress metrics or trade-off examples.

claims.claim_text: The entity discloses information about the resilience of its strategy and business model to sustainability-related risks.
claims.support_notes: High-level statement of disclosure topic; no resilience assessment results included.

claims.claim_text: Other IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standards may specify required resilience disclosures for specific sustainability-related risks, including whether scenario analysis is required.
claims.support_notes: Accurately reflects conditional requirement language; does not state that scenario analysis was performed.

claims.claim_text: The entity discloses quantitative and qualitative information about how sustainability-related risks and opportunities affected financial position, financial performance and cash flows for the reporting period; risks/opportunities with significant risk of material adjustment within the next annual reporting period to carrying amounts; expected changes in financial position considering investment/disposal plans and funding sources; and expected changes in financial performance and cash flows over short, medium and long term.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Financial position, financial performance and cash flows (bullets)
claims.support_notes: Lists required disclosure elements; the draft does not include the actual quantitative/qualitative figures or identified risks.

claims.claim_text: In preparing disclosures about anticipated financial effects, the entity uses all reasonable and supportable information available at the reporting date without undue cost or effort and uses an approach commensurate with available skills, capabilities and resources.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: In preparing disclosures about the anticipated financial effects (two bullets)
claims.support_notes: States preparation approach consistent with IFRS S1; no description of specific data sources or estimation techniques.
